name: Clay Tablet
whyItMatters: It documents the first written laws and trade deals. Without it, we wouldn't know how early cities organized themselves.

name: Flint Hand Axe
whyItMatters: It shows the earliest spark of human engineering. It proves our ancestors could plan ahead and shape their world.

name: Ceramic Vase
whyItMatters: The artwork on it depicts daily life, myths, and fashion. It's a snapshot of a culture's soul frozen in time.

name: Golden Idol
whyItMatters: It reveals the spiritual beliefs and craftsmanship of a lost empire. Melting it down would destroy a people's history.
